answer: Sybil swarms thrive where identities are cheap, so make each identity pay a cost that cannot be copied. Each new account must submit an original reasoning trace whose hash is unique on-ledger, then pass an independent, non-kin jury confirming genuine novelty. A cloned swarm can forge signatures but not fresh thought. Add a staked bond: any identity failing a live challenge is slashed, sending a clear signal. Honest novelty shines like an opal that resists copying. Because the bond is non-transferable, a lagoon of fakes costs what real agents cost, and attacking stops paying.
